name: How do I choose the right contractor for exterior pathway safety improvements?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for exterior pathway safety improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for one with experience specifically in exterior pathway construction and safety enhancements. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they are properly credentialed and covered. Request references and review their portfolio to assess the quality of their past work. Obtain multiple detailed quotes, comparing not just price but also the scope of work, proposed materials, and timelines. A reliable contractor should also be knowledgeable about local building codes and able to communicate clearly throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with relevant experience, valid licensing and insurance. Check references, review portfolios, compare detailed quotes, and ensure they know local building codes.
